_note: Slots for [brg_team-hero]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Slot names are underscore-only. Defaults are esc_html'd, so write literal characters, never `&` or `—`.\n\nTHE <h1> IS WIRED. Approved editable by Sean 2026-08-13. LENGTH IS A HINT, NOT A LIMIT — under ~50 characters keeps it to 3 lines at 1440, but character count is only a proxy because WORD length drives the break: careers-hero renders 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero renders 3 at 43, same rule and same width. 4 lines is the practical ceiling; at ~70 characters the headline is 5 lines and consumes the whole fold, pushing the next section off-screen. Measured, not guessed. The hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type — before that fix the top mark fell 43px between a 3-line and a 5-line headline and ended up level with the first line. This one is far under the budget, so it has the most room of the four.

heading.label: Headline
heading.doc: The hero display headline. Approved editable by Sean 2026-08-13. LENGTH IS A HINT, NOT A LIMIT — under ~50 characters keeps it to 3 lines at 1440, but character count is only a proxy because WORD length drives the break: careers-hero renders 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero renders 3 at 43, same rule and same width. 4 lines is the practical ceiling; at ~70 characters the headline is 5 lines and consumes the whole fold, pushing the next section off-screen. Measured, not guessed. The hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type — before that fix the top mark fell 43px between a 3-line and a 5-line headline and ended up level with the first line. sub_1.label: Sub copy — before the pink word
sub_1.doc: Opening clause. The space before the pink word is in the markup, so no trailing space here.
sub_1.default: We're operators, leaders, community builders — and yes, we all have strong opinions about

sub_highlight.label: Sub copy — the pink word
sub_highlight.doc: Rendered in brand pink, mid-sentence. One word or a very short phrase.

sub_2.label: Sub copy — after the pink word
sub_2.doc: The rest of the sentence. Starts immediately after the pink word with no space, so begin with the punctuation.
sub_2.default: . This is the team behind the brands.

uline_variant.label: Underline animation
uline_variant.doc: How the hand-drawn underline (line-team-lg.svg) reveals. `u3` (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe, keeps the taper. `wipe` straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback. `u1` scaleX bar — this is what this hero used BEFORE the artwork swap, kept so the old look can be compared live. Unknown or blank renders the mark static and visible, never hidden. Catalogue: website/lab/README.md.

bg_photo.label: Background photo
bg_photo.doc: Optional. Leave this empty and the hero keeps the flat dark color it has today — nothing changes until you choose a photo. The photo fills the whole hero and is cropped to fit, so its exact size does not matter; around 1920px on the long edge is plenty and anything bigger only slows the page. Light photos make white headlines hard to read, which is what the two overlay settings below are for. If you also set a background video below, this photo is what shows while the video loads and for anyone who has animation switched off.

overlay_color.label: Overlay color
overlay_color.doc: A flat color laid over the background photo to keep the headline readable. This does nothing when no photo is set. Choose None to turn the overlay off entirely.

overlay_strength.label: Overlay strength
overlay_strength.doc: How much of the overlay color shows through. Only has an effect once an overlay color is chosen above. 45% is the usual setting for white type over a photo — go higher if the headline still fights the picture, lower if the photo is already dark.

video_id.label: Background video (optional)
video_id.doc: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or just the ID. Leave blank to use the photo above, or the flat hero color if there is no photo. The video plays silently on a loop with no controls. The photo shows while the video loads, if the video is blocked, and for visitors who have switched off animation — so it is worth setting one as well.

video_source.label: Video from
video_source.doc: Which service the link is from. Only matters when a video is set.
